Research It So I Don't Have To

Research something thoroughly without reading an encyclopedia afterward.

What it does

It does the research, then puts the answer in this order:

  • What matters
  • What changed the answer
  • Tradeoffs
  • Recommendation criteria
  • Unresolved questions
  • What to do next

When to use it

  • You need to understand something well enough to decide, and you don't have six hours.
  • You're comparing things to buy, book or sign up for.

What to give it

  • The question. The real one.
  • What you're going to do with the answer.
  • Anything you already know or already ruled out.

What you get back

  • A short answer with the tradeoffs, not a report.
  • The questions nobody could answer yet.
  • What to do next.

How to use this in Claude

  1. Download the .zip. Don’t unzip it.
  2. In the Claude app, open Settings and find Skills.
  3. Upload the .zip and switch it on.
  4. Start a new chat and just ask for the thing. Claude picks up the Skill on its own.

Works on any Claude plan that has Skills turned on.
